value.answer: There's no single 5-year fixed rate. It depends on the lender and on whether your mortgage is insured (under 20% down) or uninsured. The lowest insured 5-year fixed I found is 4.34%, from Ratehub and Wowa. The lowest uninsured one is 4.44% from Wowa, but Wowa's own numbers don't agree, so treat that as not confirmed. The big banks are higher: one of the Big 6 is at 4.54% and Scotiabank at 4.74%. Fixed rates have been climbing since early September. I couldn't find a Toronto or Ontario figure, so these are national. Whether it's insured or uninsured, and a new purchase or a renewal, changes which number applies to you.
